rows.text: Crrk crrk — When it comes to building design, there are three things to consider: Fairness, fairness, and fairness.
rows.speaker: Fair Nymph

rows.text: Just like the two ends of a scale. Suppose there is a treasure on one side of the stairs then so, too, must there be something on this side... like a bug!
rows.speaker: Fair Nymph
